decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9604. Series context: trend strength 0.9982 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.096); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.3.
